text_block_list.text:
The day of the Ibis Summer Dash.
As soon as Calstone Light O arrived at the venue,
she was overflowing with energy.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! What a magnificent straightaway!
The starting point is so far away!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Straight ahead! With all my might! I can run!!
I'm so excited! My tail's thrashing so much it might rip right off!
choice_data_list: Calm down! It's way too early to rush!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That is true.
I must save my strength for the race!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, look, look! I changed the Umalator to Niigata Racecourse too♪

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: I wanted to take in the same atmosphere as Right-O-chan, too.
Godolphin Barb peers out from the Umulator app on the smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've gotten a bit carried away too.
I shouldn't be talking about Right-O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Of course!
It's our first time going out to watch a race together!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"I was the same way. The first time I entered the stands,
I was so thrilled by how long and straight it was!
I must have walked back and forth countless times."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so this is Niigata's straight track!
Aren't the stands and the course pretty close?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
An outside gate means she'll be super close.
Let's head up front to watch, since we're here anyway.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone seems thrilled for the home stretch too.
I can feel the anticipation to witness top speed!

Because it's a straight course, you can accelerate all the way to top speed in one go.
You're guaranteed to see that Umamusume's absolute fastest run.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why. Shivers are running down my spine.
I can't wait for the race to begin.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I feel an overwhelming urge to just scream!
choice_data_list: Let's channel that impulse into the race!

text_block_list.text:
What she's feeling is likely the thrill of battle.
—It looks like we can expect a run like never before.
Hmm, we certainly have quite the lineup of swift Umamusume today.

"The Ibis Summer Dash is a straight course,
so it'll undoubtedly be a pure battle of speed."
Now then, who is the fastest of them all!?
